scenes.title: Lift the Handle
scenes.summary: Camila arrives for her first morning shift and Jorge shows her the trick to the front door and his paper ledger.

scenes.title: Warm Rolls and Two Rings
scenes.summary: Morning baker Bianca welcomes Camila with fresh bread and warns her about Room 4's double buzzer.

scenes.title: Where Are My Glasses?
scenes.summary: Anxious owner Otavio rushes in worried about today's Room 4 arrival while hunting for the glasses on his forehead.

scenes.title: Room Four on the Second Floor
scenes.summary: Retired music teacher Helena checks into Room 4 with a heavy blue suitcase after a long train ride.

scenes.title: Not My Clothes!
scenes.summary: Upstairs in Room 4, Helena opens the blue suitcase and discovers men's shoes and a wooden toy train instead of her clothes.

scenes.title: The Luggage Tag
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Otavio reads the tiny handwriting on the suitcase tag while Camila calls the station office.

scenes.title: Tea and a Warm Cardigan
scenes.summary: Bianca lends Helena a clean soft cardigan and pours herbal tea while Jorge locks the mystery suitcase safely away.

scenes.title: Left on the Step
scenes.summary: Late at night the front bell rings, and Camila and Jorge find Helena's real suitcase on the step with an anonymous note.
